purpose: Prevent a continuing user instruction from ending as a chat-only promise; require current-authority classification and route missing semantics into an auditable change-bound Work Unit.

outcomes.already_governed: APPLY_EXISTING_AUTHORITY; record authority IDs/paths; do not end on chat memory alone
outcomes.duplicate: DO_NOT_CREATE_NEW_RULE; apply existing authority; record authority IDs/paths
outcomes.conflict: FAIL_CLOSED; do not progress until conflict is resolved
outcomes.extension_needed: ADD_ONLY_MISSING_SEMANTICS; create or update a change-bound candidate Work Unit
outcomes.new_rule_needed: CREATE_NEW_RULE_CANDIDATE; create a change-bound candidate Work Unit

evidence_required: authority IDs/paths when already governed or duplicate
